ValidationRule.description: Completed logs are immutable. Once Action_Type = APPLY_COMPLETED, the snapshots and target record cannot be edited manually. This preserves the forensic integrity of the audit trail.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(Action_Type__c, 'APPLY_COMPLETED'), OR( ISCHANGED(Before_Snapshot_JSON__c), ISCHANGED(After_Snapshot_JSON__c), ISCHANGED(Target_Record_Id__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Completed request update logs are read-only. The before/after snapshots and target record cannot be modified after the apply completes.
